Districts carry Local Government Directory (LGD) codes. Simplified and converted for this map; disputed slivers and the two districts without an LGD code (Muzaffarabad, Mirpur) are left out, and districts created after the survey (Hnahthial, Khawzawl, Vav-Tharad) are drawn inside the district they came from.
